name: Sint Maarten
facts: Constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands

flag.description: Two equal horizontal bands of red over blue, with a white triangle at the hoist bearing the coat of arms under a rising sun and a pelican.
flag.symbolism: Red, white and blue are the colors of the Netherlands; the arms show the courthouse in Philipsburg, the yellow sage flower and the monument to Dutch-French friendship on the island.

hook: Sint Maarten is the Philippines flipped, red on top, blue below, and a coat of arms with a pelican in the white triangle instead of a golden sun and stars.
trivia: The island of Saint Martin is shared with France: Dutch Sint Maarten in the south and the French Collectivity of Saint-Martin in the north.
The motto on the coat of arms is Semper pro grediens, "always progressing".
